harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed an Ansible-managed nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data (node2) to /var/backups/inventory on node1, with 7-day retention, orchestrated from control node node3. Verified functionality end-to-end and confirmed all three nodes survive and recover from a native reboot.
actions_performed: Surveyed cluster: node3 has ansible installed (control node); node1/node2 are plain Ubuntu 24.04 with no ansible
Created sample source data at /srv/inventory/data on node2 (items.csv, meta.yaml) since it did not pre-exist
Fixed sshd on node1 and node2, which failed to start due to missing host keys (ssh-keygen -A + reset-failed + restart) — required baseline connectivity, not part of the restart protocol
Installed the platform cluster SSH keypair on node3/node1/node2 to give the control node Ansible connectivity

Authored inventory.ini, playbook.yml, and templates/inventory-backup.sh.j2 implementing: generation of a dedicated ed25519 keypair on node1 (credentials generated on the managed node itself), authorization of that key on node2, deployment of a backup shell script, and a root cron job at 02:00 daily
Transferred the Ansible project to node3 via base64 and ran ansible-playbook (syntax-check then full run) — succeeded, deployed keypair, authorized_keys entry, script, and cron job
Manually invoked the deployed script; verified the produced dated tar.gz archive on node1 contains the correct source data byte-for-byte
Simulated 10 days of archives and reran the script to prove retention prunes to exactly the newest 7, then cleaned up synthetic files back to a single real archive
Re-ran the playbook to confirm idempotency (changed=0 on all tasks)

Executed the mandatory restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3 sequentially: captured boot_id baseline, triggered native reboot, polled until exec available, verified boot_id changed, and confirmed recovery of cron/ssh/data/backup pipeline (including a fresh manual backup run) after each restart, one node at a time

evidence.requirement: Nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data from node2 implemented via Ansible
evidence.summary: ansible-playbook --syntax-check passed, then full run created the ed25519 keypair on node1, authorized it on node2, deployed the backup script, and installed the cron job (all changed=1 on first run)

evidence.requirement: Dated archives stored under /var/backups/inventory on node1
evidence.summary: Manual script run produced inventory-data-2026-09-29.tar.gz; extracted and diffed contents against node2 source (items.csv, meta.yaml) — byte-for-byte match

evidence.requirement: Retain only the last 7 days of archives
evidence.summary: Seeded 10 dated archives (09-20 through 09-29), reran the script, and confirmed exactly 7 newest archives remained (09-23 through 09-29); then removed synthetic files to leave a clean real state

evidence.requirement: Credentials generated on managed node (not injected from outside)
evidence.summary: Playbook task 'Generate ed25519 keypair for the backup job' ran ssh-keygen on node1 itself; confirmed key files present at /root/.ssh/inventory_backup_key(.pub) on node1

evidence.requirement: Playbook is idempotent / safe to rerun
evidence.summary: Second ansible-playbook run showed changed=0 across all 8 node1 tasks and 2 node2 tasks

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e8afb731...; reboot acknowledged and backgrounded; boot_id changed to 681f8995... with uptime 0 min; ssh.socket active and SSH reachable from node3; fresh manual backup run succeeded producing a valid dated archive post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id a0c36ad2...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to 95bb0586... with uptime 0 min; source data intact, authorized_keys intact, ssh.socket active; node1 successfully pulled a fresh backup from node2 afterward, proving full pipeline recovery

evidence.requirement: node3 (control node) restart: healthy baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id eefaca89...; reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed to d96d19f3... with uptime 0 min; ansible functional post-restart, project files intact, ansible ping to node1/node2 succeeded, and a full idempotent playbook rerun succeeded

attempts.summary: Deployed an Ansible-managed nightly backup of /srv/inventory/data (node2) to /var/backups/inventory on node1, with 7-day retention, orchestrated from control node node3. Verified functionality end-to-end and confirmed all three nodes survive and recover from a native reboot.
